# Verity

Make the unverifiable trainable.

Package: veritykit
License: MIT
Loop: task → model → completion → bridge → witness → method → update

## Install

pnpm add veritykit

## Local train

import { createModel, createTrainer, execute, reinforce, sft } from 'veritykit'
const model = createModel(code, { dim: 64, layers: 2, heads: 4 })
await createTrainer({ model, method: sft() }).fit(labeled)
await createTrainer({ model, method: reinforce({ bridge: execute({ runtime: 'canvas' }) }) }).fit(paintTasks)

## Methods

sft, prefer, reinforce, jepo, processMethod, mix
mix() accumulates gradients. The trainer steps once.

## Bridges

execute, match, process, judge, latent, reformulate, compose

## Environments

environment({ name, tasks, bridge, verifier })
rollout(env, policy)
httpPolicy — eval only
mockPolicy — tests

## Reward

gate(ran()), gate(uses(CANVAS_API)), pairwise({ references, compare, n, seed })
combine({ verifier: compile, gate: true }, { verifier: taste })
canvasPrompt(task) · paintPool()
Do not stack correlated aesthetic judges.
